entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance purposes. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thanks for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return the VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It doesn't work right. It's basically a piece of garbage.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. I can connect you with our technical support team. They can walk through a few steps that often resolve these kinds of sensor issues.
No. I don't have time for all that. I just want my money back. I want a refund.
I understand your frustration. Of course. Let me just pull up your order and our current policy. One moment.

Okay, thank you for your patience. I see you received the item 22 days ago. Looking at the policy here... yes, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for you.
Fine. Are you sending a shipping label?

Yes, I'm generating a pre-paid return label now and I will email it over to you. I also see you're a VIP member with us. For the inconvenience with the defective device, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account for a future purchase.
Whatever. Just make sure the full refund hits my card.
Absolutely. Once our warehouse receives the return, the refund will be processed to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Can I help with anything else today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
